basic_details.job_title: Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike UGD Helper Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 45 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike is recruiting for 45 UGD Helper posts, with applications sent by post to the Office of the Commissioner, Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike up to the last date of 7 November 2026. The application process starts on 8 October 2026. Eligible candidates must hold a PUC pass with UGD Helper / Sanitary Inspector course, have knowledge of Kannada language, and meet the maximum 55 years age limit, noting that wet well/STP workers cannot apply. content_sections.text: Candidates must obtain the prescribed application format from the office. Filled applications along with required documents must be sent by post to the following address: The Commissioner, Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike, Office, Gandhipark Opp, Shivamogga, Pin Code: 577201

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made through direct recruitment based on merit and evaluation of service conditions as per the Karnataka Municipal Corporations (Cadre and Recruitment) Rules 1976 and subsequent amendments. Existing contractual, daily wage, or outsourcing workers working in similar capacities in Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike are granted weightage based on their service duration, excluding wet well and STP workers. Maximum age limit rules apply as per the notification.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format available from the Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike office. The upper age limit is capped at 55 years as per special recruitment rules 2026. Wet well and STP contract or outsourced workers are excluded from applying for these posts. Applicants must have a working knowledge of reading and writing the Kannada language. Incomplete or late applications received after 7 November 2026 will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for UGD Helper?
faq.answer: A total of 45 vacancies are available under this notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by post is 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed PUC along with a UGD Helper or Sanitary Inspector course.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 55 years, governed by the Karnataka Municipal Corporations rules.

faq.question: Q5. Are wet well or STP workers eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, wet well and STP workers are explicitly excluded from applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for the UGD Helper post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Rs. 27,000 to 46,675.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates must obtain the prescribed application form from the office and submit it by post to the Office of the Commissioner, Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application start date?
faq.answer: The application process commenced on 8 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted within Shivamogga Mahanagara Palike.
